$comment: Day 1: Basic Competencies — 8 modules, one per BHS NC II competency (docs/training-modules-plan.md §C). Facilitated training: a course_sessions row is an optional cohort/reporting wrapper (§A of the plan); this course also works taken solo. org_unit_id is a load-time decision (--org-unit), not authored here.
title_fil: Araw 1: Mga Pangunahing Kakayahan ng BHW
description_fil: Walong modyul tungkol sa tungkulin ng BHW, polisiya at karapatan, pakikipagtulungan sa barangay, at pangunahing kasanayan sa pagtatrabaho — batay sa TESDA BHS NC II na mga kakayahan.
description_en: Eight modules covering a BHW's roles, the policies and rights that support the work, working with the barangay, and core workplace competencies — mapped to TESDA BHS NC II.
